verdict.rationale: Modal's docs state that Sandboxes support "Custom images, any dependency" and show creating a Sandbox with a specified Image. Snapshots (SandboxSnapshot) offer a way to save and reuse sandbox state as template-like starting points. missing for 10: explicit evidence of bringing an existing container image from an external registry or Dockerfile, in-depth image-definition docs in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of custom image use.
